source_prodcom: Eurostat DS-059358, EU27_2020; selected PRODCOM products and PRODQNT quantity of sold production.
source_comext: Eurostat DS-045409, reporter EU27_2020, partner EXT_EU27_2020, flow 1 (IMPORT), CN8, QUANTITY_IN_100KG; annual 2008–2022.
official_mapping: EU Vocabularies PRODCOM List 2022, item-level RDF linked data; PRODCOM-to-CN references and units recorded in eu27_selected_product_code_mapping.csv.
unit_conversion: Comext QUANTITY_IN_100KG multiplied by 100 to kg; selected PRODCOM physical units are KG.
caveats: PRODCOM is sold production quantity, not total industrial output or tonnes of CO2.
CN2022 crosswalk used to select product-level import series; check annual CN/PRODCOM nomenclature stability before extending outside 2008–2022.
The simple import-share proxy excludes exports and intra-EU trade and is not full apparent consumption.
OECD embodied carbon remains available only at broader NACE activity level, not these exact products.
One-sided Spearman tests are exploratory; Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted across eight product-indicator tests; no autocorrelation correction.
